reason: Owner decision: a queued follow-up parks for review only when a security-relevant runtime field changes. The queue compared the provider/harness profile revision, and every harness turn records session/turn evidence on its profile, so a follow-up queued during a harness turn always parked with 'Runtime authorization changed'. The queue now stores and compares a digest of the profile's authorization fields (harness: kind, connection, executable/home/endpoint, auth and secret ref, default model, permission mode, privacy, native capabilities; provider: type, endpoint, locality, secret refs, model allowlist/default model, capabilities, privacy, per-model verification status); legacy items keep the revision comparison. test_reviewed_follow_up_releases_completed_harness_goal_handoff now parks via a permission change (deliberate contract change). Selected: the harness goal/queue suite with the new both-way tests, the chat queue suite and queue positions.
exclusions: test_harness_chat_goals.py::test_late_subagent_report_resumes_parked_harness_goal_once (flaky on main; fixed separately in #1026) and ::test_goal_resume_uses_saved_next_harness_in_same_chat (2 params) fail identically on pristine origin/main and with this patch, so they are excluded. No UI, native or Playwright cases: no frontend code changed. No real-Core check: this host has no inert harness executable (the installed vendor CLIs would contact external services).
